targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) as time, COUNT(*) as requests FROM monitoring.api_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) as time, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) as p50, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) as p95, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) as p99 FROM monitoring.api_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) as time, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code >= 500) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100 as error_rate FROM monitoring.api_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT endpoint, method, COUNT(*) as requests, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)::numeric, 2) as avg_duration_ms FROM monitoring.api_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY endpoint, method ORDER BY avg_duration_ms DESC LIMIT 10
